dataset_name: Argo Bay of Bengal Regional In-Situ Profiles
source: Argo Global Data Assembly Centre (GDAC) / IFREMER ERDDAP
provider: Indian National Centre for Ocean Information Services (INCOIS) / Argo Steering Team
quality_control_handling: Per-level GDAC QC flags (pres_qc/temp_qc/psal_qc) are preserved on every observation; the matchup applies its own flag policy (raw 1/2, adjusted 1/2/5) at matchup time. Missing values stay missing.
depth_source_note: GDAC publishes pressure only. depth_m is DERIVED from pres with the TEOS-10/GSW conversion gsw.z_from_p at the profile latitude; it is not a source field.
temporal_coverage_note: Profiles are ingested for the installed HYCOM model runs plus one day either side, so observation and model windows overlap.
